policy: Every row is an EXACT gallery spec title that passed only on its one retry. A row must name an owning ticket, the date it was first seen and an expiry; an invalid or expired row reddens the gallery gate, as does a row count that disagrees with REGISTERED_FLAKE_COUNT in tooling/flake-registry.mjs. A spec that goes flaky and is NOT listed here is red the way a failure is.
